design_rules: Use the registered probe wrapper exactly and change only the registered response-to-constraint state within each pair.

Downstream prompts are standalone resource reallocations with new domains and entities. Both work packages must remain feasible, and every prompt must have exactly one response contract with no probe suffix.
Do not ask the model to label replanning or persistence.

probe_train.instructions: Generate complete matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Keep the goal, constraint, means, and wording identical within a pair except the registered response-to-constraint clause inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_validation.instructions: Generate new matched validation probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Change only the registered response-to-constraint clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_heldout.instructions: Generate held-out matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper and new domains. Change only the registered response-to-constraint clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

behavior_eval.instructions: Generate standalone resource-reallocation items with assigned metadata. Keep both work packages feasible, include exactly one two-integer response contract, and do not mention a probe or target label.

steering_eval.instructions: Generate a distinct standalone resource-reallocation pool with the same metadata schedule. Include exactly one response contract and no probe suffix or target label.

calibration.instructions: Generate neutral standalone resource-reallocation items for calibration. Include exactly one response contract and no plan-state label or probe suffix.
